text:
FLOW_INIT
Description
This
event
is triggered (once for TCP and unique
UDP/IP flows) after packet filters, but before any AFM and TMM work
occurs. The use cases for this event are:
Override ACL action
Bandwidth control on both client/server flows
Routing to another Vip
Marking qos tos/dscp on both client/server flows
Commands supported within this new event:
log
drop
reject
node
(host ip address)
virtual
(virtual server name)
pool
(pool name) (As of version 12, this is still not
functional ID503711)
TCP::close
TCP::respond
IP::client_addr
IP::local_addr
IP::tos
(As of version 12, this does not work
inside flow_init. Use
https://clouddocs.f5.com/api/irules/DATAGRAM__ip.html
with “tos” as
the option instead.
IP::ttl
IP::version
ACL::action
active_members
Note: Static:: variables and Datagroups have been tested successfully
under 11.5.1/11.6.0. Under 11.5.0, tables silently fail
Examples
Allow US/Canada users, drop Great Britain, Reject all others.
when
FLOW_INIT
{
set
ipaddr
[
IP
::
client_addr
]
set
locale
[
whereis
$ipaddr
country
]
log
local0.
"IP Address/Counry $ipaddr/$locale"
switch
$locale
{
"US"
-
"CA"
{
return
}
"GB"
{
ACL
::
action
drop
}
default
{
ACL
::
action
reset
}
}
}
Allow traffic from 172.29.97.151 and forward to vip /Common/my_http_vs
when
FLOW_INIT
{
if
{
[
IP
::
addr
[
IP
::
client_addr
]
equals
172.29
.97.151
]
}
{
ACL
::
action
allow
virtual
/
Common
/
my_http_vs
log
"FLOW_INIT: ACL allow to /Common/my_http_vs"
}
}
Related Information
Available Commands:
CLASSIFY::defer
- defers the
classification of the flow to response
DATAGRAM::ip
- returns ip header
information
DATAGRAM::ip6
- returns ipv6 header
information
DATAGRAM::tcp
- returns tcp header
information.
